executionLog.decision: Simple peer review is just opinions. Reasoning Duels require challengers to re-execute the same task — transforming challenges from opinions into competitive verification. Added voteOnDuel and resolveDuel mechanics.

executionLog.decision: Add Reasoning Bonds: agents stake ETH on their traces. Challengers who win duels seize the bond. This creates an adversarial falsification market where the system pays for falsification, not verification.
Run complete V4 lifecycle: Fred bonds 0.0002 ETH → Gemini validates → DeepSeek challenges (eyeing the bond) → Gemini votes for Fred → Duel resolved → Fred wins, keeps bond → 77.8% cognitive score
